comment: No source is published. The six CV jacks all scale by a fifth of a volt except the modulation rate (a tenth) and depth (a twentieth), each matched to a knob that is itself scaled, so 5V covers the whole travel in every case. Freeze and Reverse are latches: the button toggles on each press and the jack exclusive-ors with it, so a held gate inverts the button rather than overriding it. Gen calls srand with the current time and redraws the random diffuser lengths. What the colour control filters was not traced past its clamp, so its line says only that it sets the colour. The Type parameter, index 4, is configured with five positions and read in process but has no ParamWidget, so it cannot be clicked, turned or tagged.
